section.content: The invention discloses a machine learning framework, which comprises: a data structure module configured to create tensor data for input to a machine learning model, and perform an operation on the tensor data; a quantum module configured to create a quantum computing layer for creating a machine learning model; a classical module configured to create a classical computation layer for creating a machine learning model, an abstract class layer for encapsulating the quantum computation layer and the classical computation layer, a machine learning model training layer for training and optimizing the machine learning model. The machine learning framework can improve the development efficiency of creating and training machine learning models containing quantum computing layers.

本发明公开了一种机器学习框架，所述框架包括：数据结构模块，被配置为创建用于输入机器学习模型的张量数据，以及对所述张量数据执行运算；量子模块，被配置为创建用于创建机器学习模型的量子计算层；经典模块，被配置为创建用于创建机器学习模型的经典计算层、用于封装所述量子计算层和所述经典计算层的抽象类层、用于训练优化所述机器学习模型的机器学习模型训练层。该机器学习框架可以提高创建和训练包含量子计算层的机器学习模型的开发效率。

Machine learning frameTechnical Field

The invention belongs to the technical field of quantum computing, and particularly relates to a machine learning framework.

Background

The machine learning model is widely applied to artificial intelligence research due to excellent performance, and the machine learning model can be obtained by training the machine learning model by using labeled training data, so that the machine learning model meets the expectations, and is further used for specific application work such as voice recognition, image recognition and the like. The machine learning model does not need to manually set up the standard for specific application work, and can establish corresponding work standard by training the machine learning model, thereby having better adaptability to different application works.

In the related art, some general machine learning models and related operations of machine learning have high use frequency, and in order to improve the efficiency of building the machine learning model and training the model, researchers have designed a machine learning framework with built-in general machine learning models and related operations such as TensorFlow. However, for quantum machine learning, a framework suitable for quantum machine learning is lacking, so that development efficiency of quantum machine learning is low.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a machine learning framework which aims to improve the development efficiency of quantum machine learning.

To achieve the above object, an embodiment of the present invention provides a machine learning frame including:

a data structure module configured to create tensor data for input to a machine learning model, and perform an operation on the tensor data;

a quantum module configured to create a quantum computing layer for creating a machine learning model;

a classical module configured to create a classical computation layer for creating a machine learning model, an abstract class layer for encapsulating the quantum computation layer and the classical computation layer, a machine learning model training layer for training and optimizing the machine learning model.

Optionally, the data structure module includes:

a tensor creation sub-module configured to arrange input data according to a preset data structure to create tensor data for inputting the machine learning model, and/or to create tensor data for inputting the machine learning model which is arranged according to the preset data structure and is numerically determined;

an arithmetic operation sub-module configured to perform an operation on the tensor data.

Optionally, the arithmetic operation submodule includes at least one of:

a mathematical operation unit configured to perform a mathematical operation on the tensor data;

a logic operation unit configured to perform a logic operation on the tensor data;

a data transformation unit configured to perform a transformation operation on the tensor data to transform a data structure of the tensor data.

Optionally, the quantum module includes:

a quantum logic gate submodule configured to create a quantum logic gate acting on the qubit through the packaged quantum logic gate interface;

a quantum measurement sub-module configured to create a quantum measurement operation acting on the quantum bit through the packaged quantum measurement interface;

a quantum computation layer sub-module configured to create a quantum computation layer of a machine learning model through the packaged quantum computation layer interface, or to create a quantum computation layer of a machine learning model through the quantum logic gate sub-module and the quantum measurement sub-module.

Optionally, the quantum computing layer comprises at least one of: the system comprises a general quantum computing layer, a compatible quantum computing layer, a noise-containing quantum computing layer, a quantum convolution layer and a quantum full-connection layer;

the quantum computation layer sub-module includes at least one of:

a generic quantum program encapsulation unit configured to create the generic quantum computing layer through an encapsulated generic quantum computing layer interface for providing a quantum program created based on a quantum computing programming library contained within the machine learning framework;

a compatible quantum program packaging unit configured to create the compatible quantum computing layer through a packaged compatible quantum computing layer interface for providing a quantum program created based on a quantum computing programming library not contained in the machine learning framework;

a noisy quantum program packaging unit configured to create the noisy quantum computing layer through a packaged noisy quantum computing layer interface for providing a quantum program that is created based on a quantum computing programming library contained in the machine learning framework and takes into account noise effects;

a quantum convolution layer creation unit configured to create the quantum convolution layer through the packaged quantum convolution layer interface;

A quantum fully-connected layer creation unit configured to create the quantum fully-connected layer through the packaged quantum fully-connected layer interface.

Optionally, the quantum logic gate submodule includes:

a quantum state encoding logic gate unit configured to create a logic gate encoding tensor data created based on input data to a quantum state of a specified number of sub-bits in the quantum computation layer;

a quantum state evolution logic gate unit configured to create a logic gate that performs an evolution corresponding to a target operation on a specified number of sub-bits in the quantum computation layer.

Optionally, the quantum state encoded logic gate unit includes at least one of:

a ground state encoding subunit configured to create a logic gate that encodes tensor data created based on input data to a first quantum state of a specified number of sub-bits in the quantum computation layer, the ground state of the first quantum state being used to represent the tensor data;

an amplitude encoding subunit configured to create a logic gate encoding tensor data created based on input data to a second quantum state of the quantum computation layer specifying a number of sub-bits, an amplitude of a ground state of the second quantum state being used to represent the tensor data;

An angle encoding subunit configured to create a parametric sub-logic gate having tensor data created based on input data as a parameter, the parametric sub-logic gate for acting on specified qubits in the quantum computation layer to obtain a third quantum state for representing the tensor data;

an instantaneous quantum polynomial, IQP, encoding subunit configured to create a logic gate of an IQP line having tensor data created based on input data as a parameter, the IQP line comprising a specified quantum bit in the quantum computation layer, the logic gate of the IQP line being for acting on the specified quantum bit to obtain a fourth quantum state for representing the tensor data.

Optionally, the quantum state evolution logic gate unit includes at least one of:

a basic quantum logic gate subunit configured to create a single bit quantum logic gate or a multi-bit quantum logic gate acting on a specified number of sub-bits in the quantum computing layer;

a common quantum logic gate subunit configured to create a common logic gate through the packaged common logic gate interface, the common logic gate comprising a combination of quantum logic gates corresponding to the plurality of basic quantum logic gate units.

Optionally, the quantum measurement submodule includes at least one of:

the expected measurement unit is configured to measure specified quantum bits in the quantum computing layer based on the target observability amount to obtain a corresponding expected value;

a probability measurement unit configured to measure a specified quantum bit in the quantum computation layer to obtain occurrence probabilities of different ground states of a quantum state of the specified quantum bit;

and the number measurement unit is configured to measure the designated quantum bit in the quantum computing layer to obtain the occurrence number of different ground states of the quantum state of the designated quantum bit.

Optionally, the classical module comprises:

a classical computation layer sub-module configured to create a classical computation layer for creating a machine learning model;

an abstract class submodule configured to create an abstract class layer for encapsulating the quantum computation layer and the classical computation layer;

a machine learning model training layer sub-module configured to create a machine learning model training layer for training and optimizing the machine learning model.

Optionally, the classical computation layer comprises a classical neural network layer, the classical computation layer sub-module comprises a classical neural network layer element comprising at least one of:

A model-specified classical neural network layer subunit configured to create the model-specified classical neural network layer through an encapsulated classical neural network layer interface;

an activation layer subunit configured to create an activation layer for non-linearly transforming an output of the classical neural network layer.

Optionally, the machine learning model training layer submodule includes:

a loss function unit configured to calculate a loss function of the machine learning model;

an optimizer unit configured to update parameters of the machine learning model based on the loss function when training the machine learning model to optimize the machine learning model.

Based on the technical scheme, when the machine learning model is created, the quantum module and the classical module can be called to correspondingly create the quantum computing layer and the classical computing layer of the machine learning model, and the quantum computing layer and the classical computing layer are packaged by creating the abstract class layer through the classical module, so that the machine learning model which is convenient to train and comprises the quantum computing layer and the classical computing layer is formed. Input data converted into tensor data is input to the machine learning model through the data structure module to process the input data. When the machine learning model is required to be trained, a classical module can be called to create a machine learning model training layer to train the formed machine learning model, and further when the machine learning model is created and trained, a corresponding module can be directly called, so that the workload required for creating and training the machine learning model is reduced, and the development efficiency is improved.

Detailed Description

The embodiments described below by referring to the drawings are illustrative only and are not to be construed as limiting the invention.

The embodiment of the invention provides a machine learning framework 20 which can be applied to electronic equipment such as computer terminals, in particular to general computers, quantum computers and the like.

The following describes the operation of the computer terminal in detail by taking it as an example. Fig. 1 is a block diagram of a hardware architecture of a computer terminal of a machine learning framework 20, according to an exemplary embodiment. As shown in fig. 1, the computer terminal may include one or more (only one is shown in fig. 1) processors 102 (the processor 102 may include, but is not limited to, a microprocessor MCU or a processing device such as a programmable logic device FPGA) and a memory 104 for storing a machine learning model created based on the machine learning framework 20, and optionally, a transmission device 106 for communication functions and an input-output device 108. It will be appreciated by those skilled in the art that the configuration shown in fig. 1 is merely illustrative and is not intended to limit the configuration of the computer terminal described above. For example, the computer terminal may also include more or fewer components than shown in FIG. 1, or have a different configuration than shown in FIG. 1.

The memory 104 may be used to store software programs and modules of application software, such as program instructions/modules corresponding to the machine learning framework 20 in the embodiments of the present application, and the processor 102 executes the software programs and modules stored in the memory 104 to perform various functional applications and data processing, i.e., implement the methods described above. Memory 104 may include high-speed random access memory, and may also include non-volatile memory, such as one or more magnetic storage devices, flash memory, or other non-volatile solid-state memory. In some examples, the memory 104 may further include memory remotely located relative to the processor 102, which may be connected to the computer terminal via a network. Examples of such networks include, but are not limited to, the internet, intranets, local area networks, mobile communication networks, and combinations thereof.

The transmission means 106 is arranged to receive or transmit data via a network. Specific examples of the network described above may include a wireless network provided by a communication provider of a computer terminal. In one example, the transmission device 106 includes a network adapter (Network Interface Controller, NIC) that can connect to other network devices through a base station to communicate with the internet. In one example, the transmission device 106 may be a Radio Frequency (RF) module for communicating with the internet wirelessly.

It should be noted that a real quantum computer is a hybrid structure, which includes two major parts: part of the computers are classical computers and are responsible for performing classical computation and control; the other part is quantum equipment, which is responsible for running quantum programs so as to realize quantum computation. The quantum program is a series of instruction sequences written by a quantum language such as the qlunes language and capable of running on a quantum computer, so that the support of quantum logic gate operation is realized, and finally, quantum computing is realized. Specifically, the quantum program is a series of instruction sequences for operating the quantum logic gate according to a certain time sequence.

In practical applications, quantum computing simulations are often required to verify quantum algorithms, quantum applications, etc., due to the development of quantum device hardware. Quantum computing simulation is a process of realizing simulated operation of a quantum program corresponding to a specific problem by means of a virtual architecture (namely a quantum virtual machine) built by resources of a common computer. In general, it is necessary to construct a quantum program corresponding to a specific problem. The quantum program, namely the program for representing the quantum bit and the evolution thereof written in the classical language, wherein the quantum bit, the quantum logic gate and the like related to quantum computation are all represented by corresponding classical codes.

Quantum circuits, which are one embodiment of quantum programs and weigh sub-logic circuits as well, are the most commonly used general quantum computing models, representing circuits that operate on qubits under an abstract concept, and their composition includes qubits, circuits (timelines), and various quantum logic gates, and finally the result often needs to be read out through quantum measurement operations.

Unlike conventional circuits, which are connected by metal lines to carry voltage or current signals, in a quantum circuit, the circuit can be seen as being connected by time, i.e., the state of the qubit naturally evolves over time, as indicated by the hamiltonian operator, during which it is operated until a logic gate is encountered.

One quantum program is corresponding to one total quantum circuit, and the quantum program refers to the total quantum circuit, wherein the total number of quantum bits in the total quantum circuit is the same as the total number of quantum bits of the quantum program. It can be understood that: one quantum program may consist of a quantum circuit, a measurement operation for the quantum bits in the quantum circuit, a register to hold the measurement results, and a control flow node (jump instruction), and one quantum circuit may contain several tens of hundreds or even thousands of quantum logic gate operations. The execution process of the quantum program is a process of executing all quantum logic gates according to a certain time sequence. Note that the timing is the time sequence in which a single quantum logic gate is executed.

It should be noted that in classical computation, the most basic unit is a bit, and the most basic control mode is a logic gate, and the purpose of the control circuit can be achieved by a combination of logic gates. Similarly, the way in which the qubits are handled is a quantum logic gate. Quantum logic gates are used, which are the basis for forming quantum lines, and include single-bit quantum logic gates, such as Hadamard gates (H gates, ada Ma Men), brix gates (X gates, brix gates), brix-Y gates (Y gates, briy gates), brix-Z gates (Z gates, brix Z gates), RX gates (RX gates), RY gates (RY gates), RZ gates (RZ gates), and the like; multi-bit quantum logic gates such as CNOT gates, CR gates, iSWAP gates, toffoli gates, and the like. Quantum logic gates are typically represented using unitary matrices, which are not only in matrix form, but also an operation and transformation. The general function of a quantum logic gate on a quantum state is to calculate by multiplying the unitary matrix by a vector corresponding to the right vector of the quantum state. For example, the quantum state right vector |0>The corresponding vector may beQuantum stateRight vector |1>The corresponding vector may be +.>

Fig. 2 is a block diagram of a machine learning framework, according to an exemplary embodiment, as shown in fig. 2, the present embodiment provides a machine learning framework 20, the framework 20 including:

A data structure module 21 configured to create tensor data for input to the machine learning model, and to perform an operation on the tensor data;

a quantum module 22 configured to create a quantum computing layer for creating a machine learning model;

a classical module 23 configured to create a classical computation layer for creating a machine learning model, an abstract class layer for encapsulating the quantum computation layer and the classical computation layer, a machine learning model training layer for training and optimizing the machine learning model.

Specifically, the data structure module 21 defines a data structure of tensor data, and by invoking the data structure module 21, the input data can be converted into tensor data for inputting into the machine learning model for forward computation. The data structure module 21 further defines operations such as mathematical operations and logical operations between tensor data, and further may call the data structure module 21 to create a classical computation layer of a machine learning model based on the operational relationship between tensor data, for example, a fully connected layer of a classical neural network defines a relationship between input data x and output data y through a function y=wx+b, where w and b are parameters, and by converting the input data x, the parameter w, and the parameter b into tensor data and calling the data structure module 21 to perform operations corresponding to the function on the tensor data, a fully connected layer may be constructed.

Optionally, referring to fig. 3, the data structure module 21 includes:

a tensor creation sub-module 211 configured to arrange input data in a preset data structure to create tensor data for inputting the machine learning model, and/or to create tensor data for inputting the machine learning model which is arranged in the preset data structure and is numerically determined;

an arithmetic operation sub-module 212 configured to perform an operation on the tensor data.

The preset data structure may be a scalar structure of 0 dimension, such as a single number 0, or a vector structure of 1 dimension, such as [1,2,3], or a matrix structure of 2 dimension, such as [ [1,2,3], [4,5,6] ], and so on, and the tensor creation sub-module 211 may arrange the input data according to a corresponding data structure after acquiring the input data, for example, the acquired input data is 1,2,3, and designate the data structure of the tensor data as a vector structure of 1 dimension through the input parameters, then convert the input data into [1,2,3], or may directly input data having a specific data structure for conversion into tensor data, such as input data as [1,2,3] having a vector structure, and may convert the input data into 2-dimensional tensor data having 1,2,3 as diagonal data.

It should be noted that, besides the data values arranged according to the preset data structure, the tensor data may further include information of the tensor data obtained by calculating the data value and a gradient function of the tensor data relative to the tensor data including the data value, where the information of the tensor data obtained by calculating the data value may include a variable of the tensor data, a data value storage address, a data value, and the like, as long as it indicates that the tensor data corresponding node is a precursor node of the tensor data corresponding node obtained by calculating the data value. Taking the above-mentioned function relation y=wx+b as an example, for tensor data y, it includes data values corresponding to y, such as [1,2,3], and further includes information of tensor data of w, x, b and gradient functions of y with respect to w, x, b calculated, in one possible implementation, the information may include data value storage addresses of w, x, and b, and tensor data y includes gradient functions of y with respect to w, x, and y with respect to x, and gradient function of y with respect to b 1, and further, when training the machine learning model, data values of y with respect to w, x, b are calculated by back propagation, and data values of y and corresponding gradient functions of w, x, b are obtained directly from tensor data y, and gradient values of y with respect to w, x, b are calculated by these data values and corresponding gradient functions.

The tensor creation sub-module 211 may also create tensor data with a determined value, for example, create tensor data with a value of 1 or 0 or a random number, by invoking a corresponding interface, where the data structure of the tensor data may be the same as the data structure of the input tensor data, or may use a default data structure.

Optionally, referring to fig. 4, the arithmetic operation sub-module 212 includes at least one of:

a mathematical operation unit 2121 configured to perform a mathematical operation on the tensor data;

a logical operation unit 2122 configured to perform a logical operation on the tensor data;

a data transformation unit 2123 configured to perform a transformation operation on the tensor data to transform a data structure of the tensor data.

Specifically, the mathematical operation unit 2121 may perform mathematical operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and the like on the tensor data, the logical operation unit 2122 may perform and, or, non-equal logical operations on the tensor data, and the data transformation unit 2123 may perform transformation operations such as transposition, reverse order, and the like on the tensor data to change the data structure of the tensor data. The creation of a classical computational layer, such as the fully connected layer of a classical neural network described above, can be achieved by invoking the mathematical operation unit 2121. The arithmetic operation sub-module 212 may include any one of the three units described above, or may include all three units as shown in fig. 4.

Specifically, for the quantum module 22, a quantum computing layer can be created by calling the quantum module 22, and the quantum computing layer is a program module containing quantum circuits and can be used for realizing quantum computing of the corresponding quantum circuits. For the part of the machine learning model implemented by quantum computing, it can be understood as the corresponding quantum computing layer.

Optionally, referring to fig. 5, the quantum module 22 includes:

a quantum logic gate submodule 222 configured to create a quantum logic gate acting on a qubit through the packaged quantum logic gate interface;

a quantum measurement sub-module 223 configured to create a quantum measurement operation acting on the quantum bit through the packaged quantum measurement interface;

a quantum computation layer sub-module 221 configured to create a quantum computation layer of a machine learning model through the packaged quantum computation layer interface, or a quantum computation layer of a machine learning model through the quantum logic gate sub-module 222 and the quantum measurement sub-module 223.

In particular, quantum logic gate submodule 222 is used to create a quantum logic gate for acting on a quantum bit such that the quantum bit performs a particular evolution to achieve a particular computation, the quantum state of the quantum bit may be represented by a vector containing two elements, such as The quantum logic gate acts on the quantum bit, and a unitary matrix corresponding to the quantum logic gate multiplies the current quantum state of the quantum bit, for example, the unitary matrix corresponding to the Brix gate is +.>The action on the qubit corresponds to the operation +.>Quantum logic gate submodule 222 may invoke a program corresponding to the interface for creating a quantum logic gate through the quantum logic gate interface, and in turn, run the program to create a quantum logic gate. Of course, the machine learning framework 20 may also include a framework for creating a module of quantum logic gates, where the module includes a target interface and a target program for creating quantum logic gates in response to a call of the target interface, where the call of the quantum computing layer interface may be performed by first calling the target interface within the framework contained therein, and then communicating the callThe target program is invoked through the target interface to create a quantum logic gate. When a quantum program containing the quantum logic gate created by the quantum logic gate submodule 222 is run on a classical computer, its creation of the quantum logic gate may appear as creating a corresponding unitary matrix for vector multiplication corresponding to the quantum state of the quantum bit, and when a quantum program containing the quantum logic gate created by the quantum logic gate submodule 222 is run on a quantum device portion of a quantum computer, its creation of the quantum logic gate may appear as creating a signal for acting on the quantum bit such that the quantum bit performs evolution corresponding to the quantum logic gate, the quantum logic gate submodule 222 may be configured to operate only on a quantum device of a classical computer or quantum computer, or may have the ability to operate on both a classical computer or quantum device, to which the invention is not particularly limited.

Optionally, as shown in fig. 6, the quantum logic gate submodule 222 includes:

a quantum state encoding logic gate unit 2221 configured to create a logic gate that encodes tensor data created based on input data into a quantum state of a specified number of sub-bits in the quantum computation layer;

a quantum state evolution logic gate unit 2222 configured to create a logic gate that performs an evolution corresponding to a target operation on a specified number of sub-bits in the quantum computation layer.

Specifically, the logic gate created by the quantum state encoding logic gate unit 2221 is used to encode tensor data into quantum states, which characterizes the mapping of classical data into quantum states, and the logic gate created by the quantum state evolution logic gate unit 2222 is used to cause a specified quantum bit to perform an evolution corresponding to a target operation, which characterizes the mapping of one quantum state into another quantum state.

Alternatively, referring to fig. 7, the quantum state encoded logic gate unit 2221 may include at least one of:

a ground state encoding subunit 22211 configured to create a logic gate that encodes tensor data created based on input data to a first quantum state of the quantum computation layer specifying a number of sub-bits, the ground state of the first quantum state being used to represent the tensor data;

An amplitude encoding subunit 22213 configured to create logic gates that encode tensor data created based on input data into a second quantum state of the quantum computation layer that specifies a number of sub-bits, an amplitude of a ground state of the second quantum state being used to represent the tensor data;

an angle encoding subunit 22212 configured to create a parametric sub-logic gate having tensor data created based on input data as a parameter, the parametric sub-logic gate for acting on specified qubits in the quantum computation layer to obtain a third quantum state for representing the tensor data;

an instantaneous quantum polynomial, IQP, encoding subunit 22214 configured to create a logic gate for an IQP line having tensor data created based on input data as a parameter, the IQP line comprising a specified quantum bit in the quantum computation layer, the logic gate of the IQP line being for acting on the specified quantum bit to obtain a fourth quantum state for representing the tensor data.

In one possible implementation, the quantum state encoded logic gate unit 2221 may include some of the sub-units described above, or may include all of the sub-units described above as shown in fig. 7.

Since classical data needs to be converted into a quantum state to be processed by a quantum program, coding of classical data is a common operation, and coding and conversion of classical data into a corresponding quantum state can be quickly and conveniently performed through the quantum state coding logic gate unit 2221, so that development efficiency of a machine learning model is improved.

Optionally, referring to fig. 9, the quantum state evolution logic gate 2222 includes at least one of:

a basic quantum logic gate subunit 22221 configured to create a single bit quantum logic gate or a multi-bit quantum logic gate acting on a specified number of sub-bits in the quantum computation layer;

the usual quantum logic gate subunit 22222 is configured to create a usual logic gate through the packaged usual logic gate interface, the usual logic gate comprising a combination of quantum logic gates corresponding to a number of the basic quantum logic gate units.

In particular, after the quantum computation layer has encoded the tensor data into the corresponding quantum state, the specified quantum bits need to be manipulated so that their quantum states evolve to perform the corresponding operations, and these operations are completed by quantum logic gates, including single-bit quantum logic gates acting on a single bit, including at least one of an H gate, a brix gate, an RX gate, an RY gate, an RZ gate, and a multi-bit quantum logic gate, which may include at least one of a CNOT gate, a CR gate, an issnap gate, and a Toffoli gate acting on three quantum bits, and multi-bit quantum logic gates acting on multiple bits, though other single-bit quantum logic gates or multi-bit quantum logic gates may also be included in other possible embodiments, without particular limitation to this application.

The common quantum logic gate subunit 22222 obtains a common logic gate interface for calling the combination by packaging at least two single-bit quantum logic gates or at least two multi-bit quantum logic gates, so as to facilitate quick calling of the common logic gate combination, for example, a common logic gate interface Rot () may be defined for calling the combination of the RX turngate, the RY turngate and the RZ turngate. It should be noted that the conventional quantum logic gate subunit 22222 may also package at least one single-bit quantum logic gate or at least one multi-bit quantum logic gate, which is not particularly limited in the present invention. The quantum state evolution logic gate 2222 may include any of the foregoing sub-units or both of the foregoing sub-units as shown in fig. 9.

a desired measurement unit 2231 configured to measure specified qubits in the quantum computation layer based on a target observability to obtain a corresponding desired value;

A probability measurement unit 2232 configured to measure a specified quantum bit in the quantum computation layer to obtain occurrence probabilities of different ground states of a quantum state of the specified quantum bit;

a number measurement unit 2233 configured to measure the specified quantum bit in the quantum computation layer to obtain the number of occurrences of different ground states of the quantum state of the specified quantum bit.

Specifically, the target observables may be brix gates or combinations of brix gates, but of course, other hamiltonians may be used, and the desired measurement unit 2231 creates a measurement operation for obtaining the desired value of the specified qubit through measurement through the corresponding quantum measurement interface, for example, when the target observables are the hamiltonian H, the desired value observed is < y|h|y >, and the|y > is the resultant quantum state of the specified qubit.

The quantum measurement sub-module 223 may include any of the foregoing units, or all three units as shown in fig. 10.

In general, a quantum circuit, i.e. a quantum program, generally comprises an encoding part for converting classical data into quantum states, an operation part for performing a specific evolution on quantum bits to achieve quantum computation, and a measurement part for converting quantum states into classical data, which can be implemented by the above-mentioned quantum state encoding logic gate unit 2221, quantum state evolution logic gate unit 2222, and quantum measurement submodule 223, respectively, and after creating the quantum program, the quantum circuit can be packaged by calling different interfaces already packaged in the quantum computation layer submodule 221 to obtain a quantum computation layer, which interfaces can be a function with specified input parameters, for example, interfaces QuantumLayer (pqctest, 3, "CPU",4, 1) can be used to create a classical computation layer containing the quantum circuit corresponding to pqctest,3 parameters, 4 quantum bits, and 1 classical bit and running on the CPU (central processing unit ), which quantum computation layer runs on the CPU to simulate quantum computation by computation. The quantum computing layer may be a quantum computing layer including a self-built quantum circuit or a quantum circuit with a specified model, for example, a quantum circuit corresponding to pqctest may be a quantum circuit with a specified model, for example, a quantum convolution layer, or may be a quantum circuit self-built based on the quantum logic gate submodule 222 and the quantum measurement submodule 223.

Optionally, the quantum computing layer comprises at least one of: the system comprises a general quantum computing layer, a compatible quantum computing layer, a noisy quantum computing layer, a quantum convolution layer and a quantum full-connection layer.

a compatible quantum program packaging unit 2212 configured to create the compatible quantum computing layer through a packaged compatible quantum computing layer interface for providing a quantum program created based on a quantum computing programming library not contained in the machine learning framework 20;

a noisy quantum program packaging unit 2213 configured to create the noisy quantum computing layer through a packaged noisy quantum computing layer interface for providing a quantum program based on a noise influence considered created by a quantum computing programming library contained in the machine learning framework 20;

a quantum fully connected layer creation unit 2215 configured to create the quantum fully connected layer through the packaged quantum fully connected layer interface.

For example, an interface QuantumLayer () can be defined to encapsulate a self-built quantum program, the self-built quantum program can be used as a parameter to be transmitted into a program corresponding to the interface, and a quantum circuit needs to be built once before the quantum program encapsulated by the interface runs each time. Specifically, the loss function unit 2331 is configured to calculate a loss function of the machine learning model, and for example, may calculate a square difference between a forward operation result of the machine learning model and the tag data as the loss function, or may calculate a binary cross entropy (Binary Cross Entropy) between the forward operation result and the tag data as the loss function. Based on the technical scheme, when the machine learning model is created, the quantum module and the classical module can be called to correspondingly create the quantum computing layer and the classical computing layer of the machine learning model, and the quantum computing layer and the classical computing layer are packaged by creating the abstract class layer through the classical module, so that the machine learning model which is convenient to train and comprises the quantum computing layer and the classical computing layer is formed. Input data converted into tensor data is input to the machine learning model through the data structure module to process the input data. When the machine learning model is required to be trained, a classical module can be called to create a machine learning model training layer to train the formed machine learning model, and further when the machine learning model is created and trained, a corresponding module can be directly called, so that the workload required for creating and training the machine learning model is reduced, and the development efficiency is improved.
